provided_skills.name: contribution-analysis
provided_skills.description: Calculate the relative contribution of different factors to a response variable using R² decomposition. Use when you need to quantify how much each factor explains the variance of an outcome.

provided_skills.name: meteorology-driver-classification
provided_skills.description: Classify environmental and meteorological variables into driver categories for attribution analysis. Use when you need to group multiple variables into meaningful factor categories.

provided_skills.name: pca-decomposition
provided_skills.description: Reduce dimensionality of multivariate data using PCA with varimax rotation. Use when you have many correlated variables and need to identify underlying factors or reduce collinearity.

provided_skills.name: trend-analysis
provided_skills.description: Detect long-term trends in time series data using parametric and non-parametric methods. Use when determining if a variable shows statistically significant increase or decrease over time.
